title: connector-slack: make ConnectorSlackPlugin's static bot token optional, so a deployment that only uses per-organization Slack tokens (the Slack DM channel) composes the plugin without a placeholder
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2

Filing gate: ② open question 3 of the #34730 step-2 build (PR #35789), routed to a follow-up by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

**What.** After #35789, `ConnectorSlackPlugin` registers a Slack client service for caller-held tokens, which the Slack DM channel uses with each organization's own token. The plugin still requires a static bot `token` option to be composed, which only the flow `connector_action` connector uses. A deployment that only delivers DMs must pass a placeholder token.

**Ask.** Make `token` optional. Without it, register only the client service and skip the flow connector, saying so once at boot. With it, behaviour is unchanged. Pin both compositions.

Blocked-by: #35789.
Suggested-grade: p3 · composition ergonomics; no user-visible defect.
Dedupe: `ConnectorSlackPlugin token optional` (searched before filing).
